title: Senior CRM Manager
description:
Headquarters: Nairobi

 URL: http://m-kopa.com

 Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

 The Impact 💚
 You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

 The Opportunity

 🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.
 🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.
 🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

 What You'll Do

 Phase 1 : Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.
 Phase 2 : Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.
 Phase 3 : Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.
 Phase 4 : Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:
 • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

• Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

• Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

• Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

• Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

 Key Metrics You'll Influence
 Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale
 Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality
 Campaign ROI and payback period across both

 Your Environment
 💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging
 Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

 What You Need
 • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

• Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

• Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

• Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

• Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

• Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

 Location & Benefits
 • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

• 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

• 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

• 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

 Our Mission 🌍
 We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 Our Impact 💚
 Our technology has created measurable change:
 • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

• Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

title: Director of Demand Generation
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role:

We’re looking for a proven B2B Demand Generation leader to own and scale our demand generation engine, reporting directly to the CMO. As Director of Demand Generation, you'll be responsible for driving predictable, scalable pipeline across self-serve and sales-led motions. This role sits at the heart of marketing and growth, integrating brand, product, content, lifecycle, and performance into a single demand strategy that fuels revenue across segments.

You’ll lead a high-performing team across all channels including paid media, SEO, ABM, Field Marketing and funnel conversion, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and RevOps to drive outcomes.

What you'll own:

  • Own and drive the demand strategy: Lead the global demand generation function across PLG and sales-led motions, aligning to our GTM strategy, ICPs, and revenue goals.

  • Deliver full-funnel pipeline growth: Drive consistent, scalable pipeline across channels (paid, SEO, ABM, lifecycle, web), tailored by segment, persona, and motion.

  • Build and scale repeatable programs: Design and execute high-impact, segment-specific campaigns that convert across startup, scale-up, and mid-market/enterprise tiers.

  • Develop our ABM motion: Create and optimise 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs to engage and accelerate high-value accounts in our upmarket GTM.

  • Partner cross-functionally to win: Align tightly with Sales, Growth, Product Marketing, Brand, and Web to deliver connected campaigns and shared pipeline outcomes.

  • Fuel pipeline with takedown campaigns: Activate targeted compete, product, and vertical plays in partnership with Rev Marketing and PMM.

  • Drive performance and experimentation: Own the reporting, optimisation, and attribution across the funnel, from signups and PQLs to revenue, using data to drive constant iteration.

  • Leverage AI to gain execution edge: Use AI to accelerate testing, targeting, personalisation, and workflow automation at scale.

  • Build the systems to scale: Ensure the right martech, data infrastructure, and operating cadence is in place to support repeatable, insight-led growth.

  • Lead a high-performing team: Hire, coach, and inspire a team of channel owners, strategists, and ops leads, driving clear accountability and shared outcomes.

Where You’ll Collaborate

  • Revenue Marketing: Partner to execute multi-channel campaigns aligned to sales-led GTM; provide reach, targeting, and conversion power to sales campaigns.

  • Growth: Coordinate on activation, onboarding, and expansion programs in PLG. Ensure alignment across product and marketing acquisition paths.

  • Product Marketing: Sync on ICPs, messaging, and conversion hooks to sharpen campaign precision and relevance.

  • Sales & BDMs: Inform outbound strategy through ABM insights and lead data; support campaign-level outbound acceleration.

  • Brand & Content: Ensure creative consistency and conversion alignment across all digital channels and surfaces.

  • RevOps & Marketing Ops: Partner on scoring, routing, attribution, funnel health, and reporting accuracy.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experienced B2B SaaS leader with 8+ years in marketing and 3+ years owning pipeline at Director or equivalent level, across both PLG and sales-led motions.

  • Proven demand driver you've built and scaled high-performing demand engines that deliver signups, PQLs, SQLs, and revenue at pace.

  • Full-stack channel expertise across paid media, SEO, ABM, lifecycle, web, and know how to integrate them into a cohesive, data-led system.

  • Commercially fluent you track CAC, velocity, LTV, and attribution with rigor, and use insight to guide prioritisation and budget allocation.

  • Segment-savvy and motion-aware you know how to tailor strategy by GTM motion (PLG vs sales-led) and segment (startup, scale-up, mid-market).

  • AI-literate and experimentation-led you constantly seek edge through automation, personalisation, and fast-cycle testing.

  • Strong cross-functional operator you partner tightly with Sales, Growth, Product Marketing, and Web to drive shared pipeline outcomes.

  • People-first leader you hire and scale high-performing teams with clarity, accountability, and a bias for impact over activity.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Technical Program Manager, Data Centers
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own the operational readiness and ongoing health of our fleet of Data Centers, both COLO and BTS sites. In this role you will be the single point of accountability for ensuring each site runs as expected — SLAs met, maintenance executed on schedule, and audits passed — across a growing portfolio of landlord-operated and purpose-built facilities. You will operate as the primary interface between Nebius and our data center landlords and operators, and you will partner closely with the Nebius IT team to translate site-level operations into reliable infrastructure for our customers.

This is an individual contributor position for someone who is equally comfortable in a contractual SLA review, a maintenance window planning call, and a physical site audit. You will define the mechanisms that keep our sites accountable and surface risk before it becomes an incident.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the operational health of Nebius COLO and BTS sites, ensuring each facility runs to expectation across power, cooling, space, connectivity, security, and environmental controls.
  • Track, monitor, and enforce SLA compliance across landlords and colocation providers; identify breaches, drive remediation, and hold providers accountable to contractual commitments.
  • Manage and coordinate site maintenance schedules — preventive and corrective — including planning and approving maintenance windows, reviewing Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and minimizing risk to live workloads.
  • Plan and drive site audits covering compliance, capacity, power/cooling performance, physical security, and safety; track findings to closure.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day interface with data center landlords and operators, managing the operational relationship, escalations, and coordination of on-site activity.
  • Partner closely with the Nebius IT team on deployments, capacity planning, incident response, and change management at each site.
  • Build reporting mechanisms and dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into site health, SLA performance, maintenance status, and open risk across the portfolio.
  • Lead incident coordination and post-incident follow-up, including root cause analysis and corrective action tracking with landlords and internal teams.
  • Track and manage contractual operational obligations, deliverables, and timelines across multiple sites and providers simultaneously.

About the team

The Data Center team is responsible for the physical infrastructure that underpins Nebius' AI cloud. We manage the full lifecycle of our COLO and BTS footprint — from bringing new capacity online to keeping live sites running reliably at scale. We work at the intersection of facilities operations, vendor management, and IT infrastructure, and we move fast because our customers' AI workloads depend on the reliability we deliver.

Basic qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical program management, data center operations, or critical facilities/infrastructure management.
  • Experience managing data center infrastructure and operations (power, cooling, space, connectivity) in colocation, build-to-suit, or owned environments.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, landlords, or service providers against SLAs and contractual obligations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs, sites, or workstreams simultaneously and drive them to measurable outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with colocation (COLO) and build-to-suit (BTS) data center models, including operating across multiple landlords and operators.
  • Working knowledge of data center SLAs, MOPs/SOPs, maintenance regimes, and audit and compliance frameworks (e.g., Uptime Institute Tier standards, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Experience supporting AI/HPC, GPU cluster, or other high-density compute infrastructure.
  • Strong familiarity with incident management and root cause analysis in a critical facilities context.
  • Experience building reporting mechanisms, dashboards, or operational scorecards for infrastructure health and risk.
  • PMP, Uptime ATD, or equivalent program/operations certification.
  • Proficiency with program and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and comfort working with operational data.
  • Willingness to travel to sites as needed.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online.

We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales.

Examples of Problems We're Solving

Determine whether a site can actually support the AI infrastructure we're planning to build. Lead multidisciplinary technical due diligence across geotechnical, environmental, civil, utility, and entitlement workstreams to determine whether a project is technically feasible before Nebius commits capital.

Build a repeatable technical due diligence program. Help establish the standards, consultant network, playbooks, and review processes that ensure every infrastructure opportunity is evaluated consistently across the Americas.

Identify technical risk before it becomes commercial risk. Work with Site Selection, Project Development, Engineering, and external consultants to identify development constraints early enough to influence negotiations, investment decisions, and project schedules.

About the Role

As a Technical Due Diligence Manager, you'll evaluate the technical feasibility of AI infrastructure opportunities across the Americas before Nebius commits capital. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll lead multidisciplinary engineering due diligence across powered land and build-to-suit developments, partnering with Site Selection, Engineering, Energy, Legal, and Project Development to identify technical risk, assess development feasibility, and support investment decisions.

This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the standards, playbooks, consultant relationships, and technical review processes you'll use are still being written—in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently lead complex technical due diligence programs while helping build the systems that make every future evaluation faster, more consistent, and more scalable.

What You'll Own

  • Lead multidisciplinary technical due diligence for powered land, build-to-suit, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities.
  • Define the scope of engineering, environmental, geotechnical, surveying, utility, and entitlement studies required to evaluate prospective sites.
  • Procure, manage, and coordinate external engineering and technical consultants from scope development through final recommendation.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development recommendations supporting acquisition decisions.
  • Prepare technical due diligence summaries and present risks, constraints, and recommendations to executive leadership.

Technical Risk Assessment

  • Evaluate geotechnical conditions, environmental constraints, utility capacity, network connectivity and fiber access, entitlement requirements, constructability, and development schedules.
  • Identify technical risks that may impact project cost, schedule, or feasibility.
  • Recommend mitigation strategies and additional investigations where appropriate.
  • Quantify technical risks and communicate commercial impacts to Site Selection and Project Development.

Studies & Consultant Management

  • Define the scope of engineering, environmental, geotechnical, surveying, utility, and entitlement studies required to evaluate prospective sites.
  • Procure, manage, and coordinate external engineering and technical consultants from scope development through final recommendation.
  • Interpret engineering studies and translate technical findings into clear development recommendations.
  • Maintain technical documentation and due diligence records that support investment decisions.

Program Standards & Process

  • Apply Nebius' technical due diligence standards consistently across all projects.
  • Help develop and improve due diligence templates, consultant scopes, checklists, and review processes.
  • Capture lessons learned to strengthen future technical evaluations.
  • Build and maintain a trusted network of engineering and technical consultants.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Site Selection to evaluate new infrastructure opportunities and support acquisition recommendations.
  • Work with Project Development to transition technically viable projects into development.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Energy, Network, Legal, Finance, and Delivery throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineering firms, land-use attorneys, environmental consultants, and technical partners.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver timely technical recommendations that support investment decisions.
  • Identify development risks early enough to influence commercial negotiations and project strategy.
  • Establish consistent technical due diligence standards across the Americas.
  • Build a trusted network of engineering and technical consultants.
  • Help build the standards and processes the Infrastructure Acquisition Group runs on as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where none exist. You know how to independently lead complex technical due diligence efforts while helping define how future evaluations should be performed.
  • 5–10 years of experience leading technical due diligence, site development, civil engineering, land development, infrastructure design, or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering and environmental consultants.
  • Strong understanding of geotechnical investigations, environmental assessments, zoning, entitlements, utility coordination, permitting, and infrastructure development.
  • Ability to interpret engineering studies and translate technical findings into business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center, AI infrastructure, or mission-critical developments.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or similar technical certification.
  • Experience with large-scale infrastructure acquisition or development programs.
  • Knowledge of utility infrastructure, transmission, and power markets.

Why Join Nebius

The infrastructure supporting AI is being built now. This is an opportunity to help define how Nebius evaluates the next generation of AI infrastructure while helping build the function itself—the standards, consultant network, technical processes, and playbooks that will support infrastructure investments across the Americas. You'll work on some of the industry's largest and most complex AI infrastructure opportunities while helping shape the physical foundation of the global AI economy.

title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs

description:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. #LI-IV1

The role

We are seeking a highly technical and experienced Network Planning Technical Project Manager to join our infrastructure team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between internal data center development teams and external telecommunications partners.

You will own the connectivity lifecycle—from initial site opportunity assessment through to the final Outside Plant infrastructure delivery—ensuring our facilities are seamlessly integrated into the global network.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of fiber optics, ISP commercial structures, and geospatial data management, coupled with the project management discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder builds across the region.

You’re welcome to work in our Amsterdam office or remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Integrated Project Delivery: Work in lock-step with other Network TPMs, DWDM engineers, ITDC (Infrastructure Technical Data Center) teams, Network Procurement, and Construction departments to ensure cohesive project execution.
  • Datacenters PoP Selection: Partner with the site selection team to evaluate connectivity feasibility. Lead the technical validation of long-haul wave proposals and dark fiber options to inform Datacenter and PoP selections.
  • Infrastructure Design: Act as the technical lead for fiber pathway architecture from the "0 manhole" to the internal access panels. Oversee the design of manhole placements, conduit systems, and site entry points to ensure optimal route diversity.
  • MMR/POE Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams on the layout of Point of Entry (POE) and Meet-Me Rooms (MMR), ensuring space, power, and structural readiness for high-capacity, multi-carrier fiber and MOFN (Managed Optical Fiber Network) arrivals.

Carrier Relations & Commercial Management

  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with regional/ Continental ISPs, private dark fiber owners, and utility providers.
  • Procurement & Negotiation: Collaborate with Network Procurement on RFx process for last-mile, middle-mile, and long-haul capacity. Lead negotiations for IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, long-term leases, and MOFN service structures.
  • Colocation: Coordinate with fiber owners to secure necessary rack space, power, and environmental resources within ILA (Inline Amplification) sites.

Network Data & Geospatial Management

  • Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
  • AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

We expect you to have:

  • Industry Expertise: 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, OSP planning, or data center connectivity project management.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    AutoCAD: Proficiency in creating and reviewing site infrastructure/conduit designs.
  • GIS: Advanced ability to work with geospatial tools and KMZ/KML files.
  • Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.
  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in negotiating complex fiber leases, IRUs, and construction contracts.
  • Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

title: IT Manager
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role

Paddle's IT team is looking for an IT Manager to lead and develop the team that keeps every Paddler equipped, connected, and secure. This is a role for someone who can operate at two altitudes at once: setting IT strategy, managing budget and vendor relationships, and leading people, while also being willing to get hands-on. You'll lead a lean team of IT engineers, own the systems that underpin how the business works day to day (identity, devices, service delivery), and be the person who pushes the function forward - using data and automation, including AI, to change how IT operates rather than just keeping the lights on.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a lean team of IT engineers - setting priorities, unblocking their hardest problems, and stepping in hands-on for complex or escalated issues.

  • Own Okta identity and access management for the business: the lifecycle, integrations, and day-to-day administration that keep joiners, movers, and leavers secure and frictionless.

  • Own macOS and Apple device management and endpoint tooling across the business, in a way that's secure by default and low-friction for Paddlers.

  • Drive the adoption of data, automation, and AI across IT operations - identifying where tooling and agents can remove manual toil, speed up support, and evolve how the team operates.

  • Set and own IT's operating rhythm: support tooling, SLAs, and the metrics that show whether the function is improving.

  • Manage the IT budget and vendor portfolio - evaluating spend, negotiating commercial terms, ensuring that we’re operating efficiently and running a SaaS estate that spans across multiple departments.

  • Implement and maintain baseline security and resilience practices for IT-owned systems (CIS Benchmarks, patching, disaster recovery), partnering closely with the wider Security team on anything that crosses into security engineering.

  • Act as the conduit between IT and the rest of the business - translating department needs into IT capabilities.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have led or managed a technical IT team before, with a track record of developing people as well as delivering outcomes.

  • Are technically credible: strong systems administration and infrastructure fundamentals, and comfortable being the escalation point when something's genuinely hard.

  • Have hands-on experience running an IAM platform in production, ideally Okta, including lifecycle automation and integrations.

  • Have in-depth knowledge of macOS and Apple hardware, ideally managing it in a corporate/enterprise environment (Iru or equivalent).

  • Are excited about AI and automation as tools for operational leverage, with examples of using them - or data and workflows more broadly - to change how a team works.

  • Can manage a budget and vendor relationships commercially: evaluating cost, negotiating terms, and knowing how to get the most out of a tool or platform.

  • Have experience running IT projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery and stakeholder reporting.

  • Understand core security and compliance fundamentals well enough to implement and maintain them.

  • Communicate clearly and adapt your message for technical peers and non-technical senior stakeholders alike.

  • Are a strong leader who can hold a calm, clear line under pressure (incidents, competing priorities, escalations).

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and wellbeing initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

About the Role

Harrogate College is looking for a dedicated Hairdressing and Barbering Apprenticeship Assessor to join our Apprenticeships department. Reporting to the Deputy Head of Apprenticeships, this role focuses on planning, coordinating, delivering, and assessing theoretical and practical learning for a caseload of apprentices.

In this role, you will deliver training both on and off-site, work closely with local employers to provide tailored training solutions. You will establish Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) with clear milestones, monitor progress, conduct formal progress reviews at least every 12 weeks, and track vocational achievements using e-portfolio systems like OneFile. Additionally, you will support the recruitment and onboarding of new apprentices, participate in quality assurance practice, and deliver constructive feedback to ensure high learner retention and timely completion.

Please note, this is a variable hours contract and working hours will vary depending on caseload demand. Based on current requirements, the role is expected to involve approximately 1-2 days per week, although this may change.

What You Will Do

  • Deliver & Teach: Lead practical and theoretical training sessions for hairdressing and barbering apprentices, covering vocational competencies and supporting Functional Skills both on-site and in workplace salons.

  • Assess & Track: Monitor learner progress against apprenticeship standards using electronic portfolio software (OneFile), mark assignments, provide constructive feedback, and ensure accurate completion of assessment paperwork to audit standards.

  • Plan & Review: Build tailored Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) with clear milestones, conduct formal tripartite progress reviews with apprentices and employers at least every 12 weeks, and ensure off-the-job training commitments are fulfilled.

  • Onboard & Collaborate: Work alongside the recruitment team to recruit, enroll, and sign up new apprentices, perform employer health and safety checks, and foster strong relationships with local salon partners.

  • Maintain Quality: Participate in internal quality assurance (IQA) procedures, uphold safeguarding and PREVENT standards, and actively drive learner retention and timely achievement targets.

About You

  • Qualifications: Level 3 Hairdressing/Barbering qualification, Assessor Award (e.g., CAVA, TAQA, A1), and Level 2 English & Maths (IQA or teaching qualification desirable).

  • Industry & Assessment Experience: Proven background in current salon practices, carrying out workplace assessments, and managing learner portfolios.

  • Employer Relationship Management: Strong track record of networking, building partnerships, and collaborating with local salon employers.

  • Teaching & Autonomy: Ability to plan and deliver practical/theoretical training independently with minimal supervision.

  • Learner Support & Target Focus: Capability to motivate a diverse range of apprentices to hit key completion deadlines and drive retention.

  • Compliance & Values: Commitment to safeguarding, PREVENT, equality and diversity, and high professional standards.

This is a broad and influential role for an HR professional who enjoys combining strong employee relations expertise with strategic workforce thinking. You will partner with managers in allocated areas, helping them navigate complex people issues while also contributing to longer-term organisational development and the delivery of our People Strategy.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as a trusted People partner to leaders and managers, offering pragmatic, balanced advice
  • Leading one mployee relations casework including performance, attendance, disciplinary and grievance matters
  • Supporting managers through change, including restructuring, workforce planning and organisational design
  • Coaching and developing leaders to build confidence and capability in people management
  • Using data and insight to inform decisions and improve outcomes
  • Working constructively with Trade Unions to maintain positive employee relations
  • Engaging with external HR networks, benchmarking best practice and bringing new ideas back into the organisation
  • Taking an active role in shaping and delivering elements of the People Strategy

What we’re looking for

This role will suit someone who:

  • Is CIPD Level 5 qualified(or above) with solid, hands-on HR experience
  • Has strong experience of employee relations in a complex or unionised environment
  • Enjoys building relationships and influencing at all levels
  • Can balance empathy with sound judgement and organisational priorities
  • Is curious, commercially aware and committed to continuous improvement
  • Wants a role where they can have real impact, not just provide advice from the side lines

Why join us?

You’ll be part of a collaborative People Services team that values professionalism, fairness and curiosity. You’ll have the space to think, the backing to challenge constructively, and the opportunity to influence how the college supports its people now and in the future.

If you’re looking for a People Partner role where relationships, judgement and values genuinely matter, we’d love to hear from you.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic, organised and committed Receptionist to join the Customer Services Team. The postholder will play a key role in delivering a welcoming, professional and efficient front-line service to students, applicants, visitors and colleagues across the College. As the first point of contact, you will provide information, advice and guidance, support student enquiries and ensure all visitors are managed in line with College safeguarding and visitor procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

The postholder will be responsible for managing the College reception and visitor management processes, ensuring safeguarding procedures are followed at all times. They will provide initial course information and application support, directing visitors and enquirers to specialist teams where appropriate. The role will also involve undertaking a range of administrative duties, including processing applications, issuing student ID cards and enrolment letters, supporting student travel enquiries, and assisting with College recruitment and promotional events.

The postholder will also manage telephone and email enquiries, ensuring these are dealt with professionally and directed to the appropriate colleagues where necessary. They will ensure the reception area remains welcoming, organised and well presented.

Who You Are:

The successful candidate will have excellent communication and customer service skills, alongside strong administrative and organisational abilities. You will be confident in dealing with a wide range of enquiries, building positive working relationships with colleagues across the College and ensuring that reception systems and processes operate effectively.

Flexibility is essential within this role, including the ability to provide occasional cover for other members of the Customer Services Team and support wider College activities as required.

title: KMAT Head of Estates & Facilities
description:
Head of Estates & Facilities

Kenilworth Multi Academy Trust

Band Q

Permanent

This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled estates professional to lead a dedicated team, oversee health and safety compliance, manage contractor performance, support capital and maintenance projects, and ensure our schools provide safe, secure and inspiring environments for pupils and staff. The successful candidate will work closely with Headteachers, the CEO and CFO to deliver effective estates management across the Trust.

Kenilworth Multi Academy Trust is a growing and ambitious Trust committed to providing outstanding educational environments in which our pupils and staff can thrive.

We are seeking to appoint an experienced, motivated and highly organised Head of Estates and Facilities to lead and develop all aspects of estates, facilities and health and safety management across our Trust.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will have responsibility for the management of Trust premises, ensuring our schools remain safe, compliant, secure and well maintained. You will provide strategic leadership for estates operations whilst also supporting the day-to-day management of facilities services across multiple sites.

The Role

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing estates, site and facilities teams across the Trust.
  • Ensuring compliance with all statutory health and safety requirements.
  • Managing contractor performance and procurement processes.
  • Chairing Health and Safety Committees and providing professional advice to school leaders.
  • Leading on risk assessment processes, emergency planning and business continuity arrangements.
  • Overseeing premises security, statutory inspections and maintenance programmes.
  • Managing compliance areas including fire safety, legionella control, contractor management and premises risk management.
  • Supporting capital works, improvement projects and planned maintenance initiatives.
  • Leading on sustainability, energy efficiency and biodiversity initiatives across the Trust.
  • Developing effective systems for asset management and maintenance tracking.

About You

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has significant experience in estates, facilities, premises or property management.
  • Has a strong understanding of health and safety legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Has experience of managing contractors, external service providers and operational budgets.
  • Has experience of leading teams and coordinating resources across multiple sites.
  • Is confident in advising senior leaders and presenting reports to stakeholders.
  • Possesses excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrates a proactive, solution-focused approach with the ability to respond effectively to operational challenges.
  • Shares our commitment to safeguarding and supporting young people.
Desirable Qualifications and Experience

We would particularly welcome applications from candidates holding qualifications such as:

  • NEBOSH General Certificate.
  • IOSH Managing Safely.
  • Facilities or Estates Management qualifications.
  • Specialist training relating to fire safety, legionella management, asbestos awareness, COSHH or premises compliance.

Experience within the education sector, academy trusts, local authorities or other public sector organisations would be advantageous.

Why Join KMAT?

This is an excellent opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping and maintaining the Trust's estate strategy, ensuring that our schools continue to provide outstanding learning environments for pupils and staff.

You will join a collaborative and supportive Trust team committed to excellence, continuous improvement and delivering the very best outcomes for our communities.

  • Excellent CPD opportunities

  • A supportive team of colleagues within the Department and across the school

  • A positive, community school environment

    A dedicated and forward-looking management team, with highly skilled staff upholding high expectations and aspirations for our students

    Employee well-being benefits via our healthcare programme to include health diagnostics, physiotherapy, 24/7 GP and mental health support, retail and gym discounts, free flu vaccination, free parking and at Keniworth site access to electric car charging and use of an on-site fitness suite

    LGPS pension scheme

Flexible Working

The postholder will be required to work across Trust sites and, on occasion, undertake evening, weekend or out-of-hours work to meet operational requirements.

We reserve the right to close this advert early and invite candidates to interview before the closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications, or a suitable candidate be found. We will be reviewing applications as they are received, therefore early applications are advised and welcomed.

title: Teacher of Science (Maternity Leave)
description:
Job Purpose

To provide

highly effective teaching of science, across all key stages, contributing to the ongoing development of the faculty. A specialism in Physics and/or Chemistry is preferred but not essential. The science faculty is very well resourced with state-of-the-art laboratories and equipment. All labs have 74-inch Interactive Promethean TVs.

The Science Faculty currently consists of:

Head of Science

Second in Science

Six additional science teachers

Two Science Technicians

The aim of science at David Nieper Academy is to develop a love and appreciation of the scientific world, as well as maximising the progress of all students regardless of backgrounds or previous academic ability. The department work closely together to fulfil these aims and support each other to maintain high standards of teaching and learning. We are looking for an applicant who can demonstrate the ability to work well as part of a team and who has no qualms about doing what is needed to help our students to success.

We are open to new ideas and innovations if they can be shown to have positive effects on the progress of our students, and welcome applicants who have demonstrated successful changes previously or who can show a willingness to try new ideas in their teaching.

Our curriculum is designed around developing strong scientific foundations at KS3 to fully prepare the students for the rigors of KS4 where they follow the AQA Trilogy pathway with higher ability students completing the Separate Science option to gain 3 GCSE’s.

Key Responsibilities

To plan, teach and assess Science across key stages 3 and 4, Physics and/or Chemistry preferred but all applicants welcome.

To be a form tutor

To contribute to the co-curricular life of the school

Participate in the academy Performance Management arrangements

Teaching and Learning

Plan and teach engaging and challenging lessons that pave the way for success in school and life

Meet the needs of all learners by consistently planning and teaching carefully differentiated lessons

Contribute to the Faculty planning and the creation and updating of schemes of work

Use regular, measurable and significant assessments of teaching

Set and mark appropriate homework

Complete all reporting on time

Closely monitor progress and attainment of all students and use it to inform teaching

Provide content for and, where necessary, deliver high quality student interventions with direction from the Head of Faculty

Work to ensure that all students achieve or exceed targets

Maintain regular and productive communication with parents about their child’s progress, behaviour and development, including attending after school parent meetings as required

Other

Undertake professional development as agreed with academy leaders

Perform additional duties and tasks required for the effective operation of the school as directed by the Headteacher

Safeguarding

Work in line with statutory safeguarding guidance (e.g. Keeping Children Safe in Education, Prevent) and our safeguarding and child protection policies

Promote the safeguarding of all pupils in the school

To undertake tasks of a similar nature and level, as directed by the Headteacher

We are delighted to invite applications for the role of Specialist Instructor at Liberty Academy. This is a full-time, permanent position and an exciting opportunity for an ambitious and passionate person.

You will complement the professional work of teachers by taking responsibility for agreed learning activities under an agreed system of supervision, consistent with the aims of the school. Activities involve planning, preparing and delivering learning lessons in the specialist subject across all key stages, as well as monitoring pupils, assessing, recording and reporting on pupils achievement, progress and development.

You will work within the classroom or appropriate area of the school site delivering lessons on Construction.

Liberty Academy is a welcoming, inclusive school at the heart of the Hull community, where every child is known, valued, and supported to achieve their potential. We place a strong emphasis on safeguarding, wellbeing, and positive relationships, ensuring pupils feel safe, supported, and motivated to attend school every day.

Liberty Academy offers a positive working environment, strong leadership support, and the opportunity to have a meaningful impact on young people’s futures within a school that genuinely cares about its community.

Liberty Academy is a large 11-16 secondary school in Hull with a strong sense of community and a high level of commitment. We are a team that believes that we can achieve anything together.

We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking candidate who can teach Construction to students and is committed to delivering high-quality, engaging lessons.

At Liberty, we value creativity and encourage new approaches to teaching and learning. Our curriculum is designed to broaden students’ horizons and enhance their cultural capital. Assessment is centrally planned to ensure consistency and to support a manageable workload, allowing staff to focus on what matters most, excellent teaching.

Our Technology Construction Specialist Instructor will provide students with engaging, practical opportunities to develop valuable skills for life, further education, and future careers. Working across the secondary school, they deliver hands-on learning in technology and construction, encouraging students to develop their creativity, problem-solving abilities, confidence, and technical skills. Through practical projects, students are supported to explore construction techniques, use tools and materials safely, and understand the importance of teamwork, precision, and resilience.

What we can offer:

  • Experienced and supportive School Leadership Team

  • Opportunities for staff to develop through Continuous Professional Development

  • Local Government Pension scheme

  • Occupational Health

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Free on site parking

Job Details

Hours of Work: 37 Hours per Week, Term Time Only (including training days)

Position Type: Permanent

Line Manager: Director of Learning Technology

Travel Required: No

The salary is dependent on current qualifications and experience, please see the attached job description for more information

Please complete the online application form to apply for this role. All candidates are advised to refer to the job description and person specification before making an application. You should use the information supplied with in the Job Description & Person Specification to make the best of your application by identifying some specific pieces of work you may have undertaken in any of these areas. Your application may be viewed in regard to some or all of the skill specific areas over the course of the selection process. Applications via agencies will not be considered.

Interviews will take place on 17 November 2026.

We are committed to safeguarding and protecting our children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All posts are subject to a safer recruitment process which includes enhanced criminal records and barring checks, scrutiny of employment history, robust referencing and other vetting checks.

Our safeguarding system is underpinned by a range of policies and procedures which encourage and promote safe working practice across the Trust. On joining you will be required to undergo continuous professional development to maintain safe working practice and to safeguard our children and young people.

title: Senior Premises Officer
description:
About The Role

At Avanti Fields, a safe, clean and well-maintained school environment is essential to creating the best possible experience for our students, staff and visitors. We are looking for a dedicated, proactive and organised Senior Premises Officer to take pride in our facilities, lead day-to-day site operations and ensure our buildings and grounds are maintained to a high standard.

In this varied and hands-on role, you will oversee premises maintenance, coordinate cleaning teams and contractors, support site security and ensure that all facilities meet the required health and safety standards. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the school site, identifying opportunities for improvement and supporting maintenance projects that enhance our facilities.

Working closely with the School Principal, Business Support Manager, Area Site Manager and wider premises team, you will help ensure that resources are used effectively and that the school's operational needs are met. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong facilities management skills, good communication and organisational abilities, and a commitment to creating a safe, welcoming and well-maintained environment where our school community can thrive.

What will you do?

  • Maintain the school's premises, grounds and car park in a clean, tidy and safe condition, including litter collection, sweeping, weed control, emptying external bins and responding to adverse weather conditions through snow clearance and gritting as required.
  • Receive, sort, distribute and dispatch incoming goods and mail, ensuring deliveries are directed to the appropriate departments, excluding specialist equipment and sensitive materials managed by the relevant departments.
  • Set up rooms, furniture and equipment for scheduled activities, meetings and school events, including open evenings and weekend events as required.
  • Monitor the school car park at designated intervals, ensuring that parking is restricted to authorised users in accordance with the school's procedures.
  • Open and close the school premises as required, ensuring buildings are secure, access arrangements are managed appropriately, and all necessary equipment and facilities are switched on or off in accordance with school procedures.

What are we looking for?

  • Good communication skills; written and verbal.
  • NVQ Level 2 or equivalent in Numeracy and Literacy.
  • General knowledge of building maintenance procedures and relevant skills
  • Understanding of Health and Safety and security issues.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Good organisational skills- ability to meet deadlines and make decisions in emergencies.

Please view the full Job Description for more information on the responsibilities and essential criteria required for this role.

If you have experience supporting literacy, numeracy or students with EHCPs and can build calm, trusting relationships, we would love to hear from you.

  • Implement strategies and provision set out in EHCPs and after discussion with the SENDCo, monitor and record impact.

  • Establish positive relationships with students to encourage inclusion and good behaviour.
  • Contribute to reviews (including EHCP / IEP reviews) and ensure agreed interventions are in place and working.

description:
About Ashlyns

A genuine sense of pride is shared by staff and students at Ashlyns, a popular and vibrant school nestled within the leafy grounds of Berkhamsted, Hertfordshire.

Ashlyns is an oversubscribed school with over 1500 students, including a successful Sixth Form that was rated "Outstanding" by Ofsted in October 2023. The school's ethos is underpinned by ethical leadership, with a strong sense of community, professionalism, and high expectations. The school's values of Integrity, Inclusivity, and Independence are central to everything we do.​

Application process

Please be aware that the school does not accept CVs. We use an anonymised shortlisting system to ensure a fair and unbiased process. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the closing date.

Questions and Adjustments

Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a Criminal Records Self-Declaration Form. All successful candidates will be subject to an Enhanced Criminal Records Disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service. For more information, please refer to our Safer Recruitment Policy, Child Protection Policy and Staff Code of Conduct.

This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. For further information on criminal record self-declaration for roles that are eligible for standard or enhanced DBS checks please refer to Nacro guidance and the MoJ website.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel - Flex Coverage Across EMEA
description:
Legal | Remote, UK | Remote, Remote



Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

This is a remote position, as part of a distributed team. To help our teams work together effectively we're looking for someone based in the UK.

Senior Commercial Counsel

We're looking for a talented commercial transactions attorney to join our team to support our commercial business in EMEA with flexibility to support across different GEOs in EMEA. In this role, you will work with the sales team, internal business partners, and other Legal team members to review and respond to requests from current and prospective customers.

As a valued member of this team, you will further grow your already existing hands-on experience drafting and negotiating a variety of customer and partner agreements and while performing matrix management across cross-functional teams. You will have the chance to contribute to team projects and contribute to our positive remote team culture. This is an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals looking to further develop their skills and become a member of the extended Go-to-Market team, while supporting strategic transactions for Atlassian (a publicly-traded Software company (NASDAQ: TEAM) with over 13,000 employees, recognized on the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For list for six consecutive years).

Your future team

Atlassian's Legal Team is seen within Atlassian as an impactful business partner, serving our business with practical and business-oriented advice and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and supportive - we love working with each other and are generous in cheering on our teammates successes.

You will report directly to the Senior Director, Head of Commercial Legal EMEA Region. Within that team, your focus will be to support transactions across different countries in EMEA. We'll determine a more focussed scope as you onboard. You will have lots of opportunity to work closely with other colleagues in EMEA and globally, both on the day job and on project work.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Be an active part of our Commercial Legal Team, which supports Atlassian's enterprise sales business.
  • Negotiate enterprise cloud and license agreements for Atlassian's products and services, including master services agreements.
  • Work in a tech forward legal team with a strong focus on AI implementation across all our workstreams
  • Partner and collaborate with other teams, such as sales, deal desk, partner & alliances, privacy, risk and compliance, security, finance, accounting, and product teams to facilitate contract reviews and internal process improvement, and development and enhancement of our customer-facing forms.
  • Providing pragmatic, business-minded guidance on contract-related issues.
  • Developing support materials and providing trainings to educate our direct sales and channel teams on contract terms and other legal issues.
  • Build trusted relationships with our sales colleagues in the region, being extremely curious about our company's business priorities and proactive in suggesting solutions.
  • Advise business and corporate functions in the region in close collaboration with our specialist teams in the US and EMEA.
  • Contribute to projects improving contract processes and sales enablement.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

About you:

  • You like to work in a team and build relationships with sales teams and have a track record doing so.
  • You take ownership and accomplish tasks seeking appropriate support.
  • You bring empathy and understanding to your conversations with customers and clients, creating a path forward that balances company risk and customer needs.
  • You enjoy negotiating and closing deals in a collaborative spirit, and you don't use a rigid approach.
  • You are not afraid to say "I don't know" and you ask many questions.
  • You enjoy working remotely and you enjoy taking up new responsibilities and work both autonomously as well as collaboratively in a multicultural team.
  • You think creatively beyond the "legal" box to offer solutions for the business.
  • You are curious and enthusiastic about AI: working with AI tooling, and following legal developments regarding AI and AI product features.

On your first day, we'll expect you to:

  • Full Netherlands, French, German, Spanish, Italian, or UK law degree (LLB/LLM) and ideally a formal bar qualification or equivalent professional registry with 8+ years PQE.
  • Have strong experience handling b2b contract negotiations and have good commercial, tech, and business acumen, particularly in SaaS and tech.
  • Be fluent in English, other languages are a plus.
  • Be curious about Atlassian's products, culture, and business model.
  • Be enthusiastic to work in an international environment, learn and take on new responsibilities.
  • Have good knowledge of privacy matters, including GDPR.
  • Have experience in the cloud space and tech contracting.

We appreciate as a plus:

  • Additional legal qualifications in other EMEA jurisdictions, particularly Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden, France, Italy or Spain.
  • Knowledge/experience in other legal areas.
  • Experience with public sector customers (public procurement) and financial institutions (FSI)

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Your future team

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Atlassian, you'll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian's AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.

What you'll do

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML-powered solutions tailored to customer needs.
  • Architect and implement robust application integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with a focus on APIs, microservices, and enterprise-scale systems.
  • Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.
  • Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

  • 10+ years of experience in backend software development.
  • 5+ years of experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development.
  • Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.
  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).
  • Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

It's great, but not required, if you have:

  • Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.
  • Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).
